quotes.text: For a new class-based system module in mail/modules, AccountManagerUtils.sys.mjs matches the PascalCase export AccountManagerUtils. Widget module files in this range use the established kebab-case family such as tree-listbox-mixin.mjs. Browser test files use browser_ plus their local feature spelling, such as browser_accountColors.js; protocol xpcshell tests use test_ircAccount.js and test_xmppAccount.js. Preserve the directory and harness family before choosing dash, camel case or underscore. Current test functions include both test_joinChat and test_openpgp_enc_nested_messages; this range does not justify forcing one task-name spelling globally.
